sources.note: Taulukko 4.1, printed p. 27 (PDF p. 28); diagnosed 1/2018–6/2022; manually transcribed from the table image — Intervals start at diagnosis, not at referral. Published only for the five collaborative areas (YTA), not for the 22 counties.

sources.title: Keuhkosyöpä Suomessa 2019–2023, Taulukko 11 — treatment groups by wellbeing services county
sources.note: Taulukko 11; crude shares, 12-month follow-up — Curative-treatment share is a proxy for Goal 3-a (poor-prognosis survival). Shares are crude. The 'no treatment record' share varies widely by county and may reflect recording, not care.

sources.title: Keuhkosyöpä Suomessa 2019–2023, Kuva 16 — age-standardised curative-treatment share by county and sex (chart estimate)
sources.note: Kuva 16 (Parantava panel); Tasan chart-digitised estimates ±1 pp; not a printed table — Age-standardised share with surgery or curative radiotherapy within 12 months, by sex. Values and 95% CIs were read from the chart; they are not published as numbers. Not stage-adjusted, not survival. Kainuu is suppressed in the figure.

sources.title: Keuhkosyöpä Suomessa 2019–2023, Taulukko 4 — stage-information coverage, whole country
sources.note: Taulukko 4 (N=14 873) — Stage missing ('Ei tietoa') for 7 097 / 14 873 = 47.7%. Strategy sub-goal 3.2 target is 90% coverage.
